Internal ID: SpearFlint | Type: Spear | Source: Workbench | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: One-handed | Crafting Materials: Wood x9, Flint x15, Leather scraps x3 | Attack speed: 1.04 s (includes picking up) | Hitbox: 1.9 range, 40 angle, 1.5 height, 0.5 ray | Movement speed: -5%

Introduction. The flint spear is the first spear. Its primary attack is a melee attack. Its secondary attack throws the spear for 1.5x damage.

Notes. • Like all spears, the flint spear floats if dropped or thrown into water.
